title: LoopFold: Parallelizing Recurrent Depth in Looped Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.35556v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped Transformers increase computation per token by repeatedly applying a shared backbone, offering a way to improve language modeling and downstream task performance at a fixed backbone parameter count. However, each loop depends on the preceding loop, so increasing recurrent depth also increases decoding latency. Existing approaches include Parallel Loop Transformers, which reduce latency by overlapping loop computation across token positions, but yield rapidly diminishing marginal accuracy gains at larger depths. To address this challenge, we introduce LoopFold, which folds computation at multiple recurrent depths into parallel batches for the same token prefix. A lightweight predictor estimates inputs to later loops so they can start before earlier loops finish. A corrector then refines the outputs of these later loops using newly available results from earlier loops. All components are trained jointly using only the final next-tok

translated_title: LoopFold：循环Transformer中循环深度的并行化
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer（Looped Transformers）通过重复应用共享主干网络来增加每个token的计算量，提供了一种在固定主干参数数量下提升语言建模和下游任务性能的方法。然而，每个循环依赖于前一个循环的结果，因此增加循环深度也会增加解码延迟。现有方法包括Parallel Loop Transformers（并行循环Transformer），它通过在不同token位置之间重叠循环计算来降低延迟，但在较大深度下其边际精度收益迅速递减。为解决这一挑战，我们提出LoopFold，它将多个循环深度的计算折叠为针对同一token前缀的并行批次。一个轻量级预测器用于估计后续循环的输入，使它们能够在较早的循环完成之前就开始执行；随后一个校正器利用较早循环新产生的结果来优化这些后续循环的输出。所有组件仅通过最终的下一个token预测目标进行联合训练（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: LoopFold通过轻量级预测器提前启动较深的循环，并用校正器利用先前循环结果对其进行精化，将循环Transformer中多个循环深度的计算折叠为并行批次，从而在不损失精度的前提下降低解码延迟。
en_tdlr: LoopFold folds computation across multiple recurrent depths into parallel batches—using a lightweight predictor to start later loops early and a corrector to refine them with results from earlier loops—thereby reducing decoding latency in looped transformers without sacrificing accuracy.
